title: Personalized Wedding Welcome Sign, Couple Portrait Decor
metaDescription: Fabric wedding welcome banner printed with your couple portrait, names and date. Three sizes from 20x60 to 35x100 inches.
bodyHtml:
A fabric welcome banner printed with your couple portrait, names and wedding date, made to hang at the ceremony entrance and keep long after the day is over. The portrait is printed from a photo you upload, so the sign shows the two of you rather than a stock illustration.

What you personalize

Add your names, your wedding date, and a photo in the fields on this page before adding the piece to your cart. You can also add a venue name or a short line of your own wording underneath. We print exactly what you submit, so read the spelling back before you check out.

Sizes and materials

  • Sizes: 20x60, 24x72 and 35x100 inches
  • Material: cotton linen blend or polyester peachskin
  • Finish: hemmed on all four edges with corner loops for hanging

Pick the size against the space you have at the entrance, and leave room for an easel or a hook above. The 20x60 suits a narrow doorway; the 35x100 works as a full photo backdrop behind a sweetheart table.

Making and delivery

Made to order. Production takes 1 to 3 business days from the moment your personalization details are confirmed, then tracked delivery takes 5 to 12 business days. If your wedding is less than 24 days away, message us before ordering so we can check the timing against your date.

Care

Spot clean with a damp cloth and hang to dry. Do not tumble dry, and do not iron directly on the printed area. Fold along the existing creases for storage and the fabric relaxes flat again within a day of hanging.

Where it works

Ceremony entrances, reception halls and photo backdrops on the day, and afterwards on a wall at home as a keepsake. Couples also order a second one as a gift for parents.

images.alt: Fabric wedding welcome sign printed with a couple portrait, names and date, on a stand at a garden ceremony
Size guide for the wedding welcome sign: 20x60, 24x72 and 35x100 inches
